## market — live quotes, trades, bars and depth for any instruments

Does: Subscribes to live market data per instrument and keeps a short recent window of each stream you subscribed to.
Needs: An InstrumentId — usually from an Instrument setting, or from the instruments block. Subscribe to every instrument the unit uses; there is no limit on how many.

Calls on `IMarketData`:
- `IDisposable OnQuote(InstrumentId instrument, Action<Quote> handler)` — Calls `handler` for every top-of-book quote; dispose to unsubscribe.
- `IDisposable OnTrade(InstrumentId instrument, Action<TradePrint> handler)` — Calls `handler` for every print on the trade tape; dispose to unsubscribe.
- `IDisposable OnBar(InstrumentId instrument, BarSize size, Action<OhlcvBar> handler)` — Calls `handler` for every bar update of one size, forming and final; dispose to unsubscribe.
- `IDisposable OnDepth(InstrumentId instrument, Action<DepthSnapshot> handler)` — Calls `handler` for every order-book snapshot; dispose to unsubscribe.
- `IReadOnlyList<OhlcvBar> RecentBars(InstrumentId instrument, BarSize size, int count)` — The most recent bars of one size, oldest first.
- `IReadOnlyList<Quote> RecentQuotes(InstrumentId instrument, int count)` — The most recent quotes, oldest first.
- `IReadOnlyList<TradePrint> RecentTrades(InstrumentId instrument, int count)` — The most recent trade prints, oldest first.
- `DepthSnapshot? LatestDepth(InstrumentId instrument)` — The latest order-book snapshot, or null before the first one arrives.

Types:
- `Quote(InstrumentId InstrumentId, DateTime EventTimeUtc, DateTime IngestTimeUtc, double Bid, double Ask, long BidSize, long AskSize, BrokerKind Source, long Sequence, bool EventTimeApproximate)` — A normalized L1 quote. · `Mid` · `Spread`
- `TradePrint(InstrumentId InstrumentId, DateTime EventTimeUtc, DateTime IngestTimeUtc, double Price, long Size, AggressorSide Aggressor, BrokerKind Source, long Sequence, bool EventTimeApproximate)` — A normalized trade print (last).
- `OhlcvBar(InstrumentId InstrumentId, BarSize Size, DateTime OpenTimeUtc, double Open, double High, double Low, double Close, long Volume, BrokerKind Source, bool IsFinal)` — A normalized OHLCV bar carrying canonical identity and provenance. · `ToBar()`
- `DepthSnapshot(DateTime TimestampUtc, IReadOnlyList<DepthLevel> Bids, IReadOnlyList<DepthLevel> Asks)` — Aggregated L2 order book snapshot at a point in time. · `BestBid` · `BestAsk` · `BestBidSize` · `BestAskSize`
- `DepthLevel(double Price, long Size)` — A single price level on one side of the order book.
- `BarSize: OneMinute | ThreeMinutes | FiveMinutes | FifteenMinutes | OneHour | OneDay`
- `AggressorSide: Unknown | Buy | Sell` — Which side initiated a trade print, when the broker reports it.

Limits: Handlers run one at a time on the unit's thread; keep them short. Recent windows hold the last 512 items per stream and start filling when you subscribe — use the history block for anything earlier. OnBar delivers forming bars too: check IsFinal.
